member.name: T:ObviousPDF.Xml.PdfXmlRenderer
member.summary: Renders a PDF from an XML document conforming to the ObviousPDF XML Schema. Implements the full processing pipeline defined in the XML requirements.
member.remarks: Internally, the XML is deserialized into the shared document model and then processed by the same rendering pipeline as the JSON renderer, ensuring identical behavior across both input formats.

member.name: P:ObviousPDF.Xml.PdfXmlRendererOptions.GenerateAccessibilityReport
member.summary:
When set to true, an internal accessibility report is generated after building the PDF document. The report is available via when using or via when using .
Disclaimer: This automated report is provided solely to assist in the assessment of document accessibility. It is not a comprehensive accessibility audit. To confirm that WCAG or PDF/UA standards are fully met, human assessment by an accessibility specialist is recommended.
